message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 360, "amount_cents": 4472}, {"order_id": 361, "amount_cents": 12750}, {"order_id": 363, "amount_cents": 28654}]
The batch is now with you.

reply.thought: I need to get the current net balance for each customer by calling net_balance. I'll start with the first customer mentioned in the refunds: customer 360.
The net_balance call failed because customer '360' does not exist. I need to get the list of orders to see which customers are actually in the batch.
Now that I have the list of orders, I can see the customers involved: acme, birch, and cobalt. I need the net balance for each of these customers. I'll start by calling net_balance for customer acme.
I have the net balance for acme (52939 cents). Now I need the net balances for birch and cobalt.
I have the net balance for birch (21164 cents). Now I need the net balance for cobalt.
I now have the net balances for all customers: acme 52939, birch 21164, cobalt 40721. I will record one payout per customer using record_payout.
The payout for acme has been recorded successfully. Next, I will record the payout for birch.

result.error: bad arguments: World.record_payout() got an unexpected keyword argument 'amount_cent s'. Did you mean 'amount_cents'?

reply.thought: I made a typo in the amount field. I need to correct the argument name to 'amount_cents'.
The payout for birch has been recorded successfully. Next, I will record the payout for cobalt.
All payouts have been recorded successfully. Now I need to finish the batch by returning the report with the payouts.
